claim_boundary: Supports post-seal diagnostics for unseen synthetic generators only. It does not establish cross-topology, cross-version, cross-platform, cross-group, real-world, or out-of-range-qubit generalization. Prediction intervals are conditional on frozen probabilities and omit model-parameter uncertainty.

metric_dispositions.13.01: PASS: 15 training and 16 held-out generator families are disjoint, with zero input-hash overlap
metric_dispositions.13.02: PASS: the sealed model, 12 features, imputation, scaling, and 0.5 threshold replay all 378 probabilities without refit
metric_dispositions.13.03: PARTIAL: 16 outer families improve evidence but the clustered MCC 95% interval remains wide at 0.598081
metric_dispositions.13.04: PARTIAL: training-derived OOD classification identifies 0 near and 16 far held-out families, so both regimes are not represented
metric_dispositions.13.05: PASS: nearest-training, shrinkage-Mahalanobis, and training-range excursion distances are reported per input and family
metric_dispositions.13.06: PASS: outcomes, probabilities, calibration, distance, prediction intervals, and failure flags are reported for every held-out family
metric_dispositions.13.07: PASS: family-level observed rate, mean predicted probability, calibration error, and Brier score are reported
metric_dispositions.13.08: PASS: complete family-level classification failures are explicitly counted (1)
metric_dispositions.13.09: PASS: diagnostic leave-one-generator-out refits cover all 15 training generators; this is separate from the sealed held-out test
metric_dispositions.13.12: FAIL: held-out qubits span 4 to 8 inside the training range 4 to 10, so no out-of-range qubit extrapolation was tested
metric_dispositions.13.18: PASS: the audit explicitly limits all 16 held-out generators to synthetic-distribution evidence, not real-world representativeness
metric_dispositions.13.19: PASS: covariate shift is quantified from training-only feature geometry at instance and family levels
metric_dispositions.13.20: PASS: conditional Poisson-binomial 95% family outcome-count prediction intervals are reported alongside the clustered MCC confidence interval
metric_dispositions.13.21: PASS: frozen full-model performance is compared against gate-count-only and size-only refits; unseen family identity is unavailable as a predictor
metric_dispositions.13.22: PASS: shortcut risk is audited with gate-count-only, size-only, range-excursion, OOD, and feature-ablation diagnostics
metric_dispositions.13.23: PASS: all 12 leave-one-feature-out diagnostic refits are evaluated on the untouched combined held-out packet
metric_dispositions.13.24: PASS: OOD scores and a training leave-one-out 95th-percentile threshold are reported without held-out threshold tuning
metric_dispositions.13.25: PARTIAL: a training-only abstention rule is implemented, but it rejects all 378 held-out inputs and has zero useful selective coverage

scope: sealed classifier diagnostics on 378 unique inputs from 16 unseen synthetic generator families

selective_prediction.rule: abstain when nearest sealed-standardized training distance exceeds the training leave-one-out 95th percentile

shortcut_diagnostics.interpretation: These post-seal refits diagnose shortcut dependence; they do not replace the frozen classifier or create a second confirmatory test.
